metadata.name: CardReplacement
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to perform card replacement process on an account which includes the shipment and embossing details.

request_fields.name: QRCode
request_fields.description: This tag is to to capture the QR Code image file URL. Valid Values: a-z,0-9 Format: url format Example: https://test/qr/d969e78921 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SignatureID
request_fields.description: This tag is to to capture the user signature image file URL. Valid Values: a-z,0-9 Format:url format Example: https://test/qr/d969e78921 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one account identifier is required.

request_fields.name: Reason
request_fields.description: Reason to identify why we are requesting card replacement. Possible Values: 1- Stolen 2- Lost 3- Damaged(Status will be marked Closed) 9- ReIssue 10- Breach 11- Other 13- Physical Card 14- Virtual Card Replacement 15- Generate New Card Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:1,9

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Flag to decide if new card need to be generated with different card number or new plastic with same embossing information. 1- New card with different card number 0- New card with same  embossing information. Valid Values: 0,1 Format:X Example:1,0

request_fields.name: DeliveryMechanism
request_fields.description: Shipment delivery mechanism. By Default Setting must be for standard Delivery and Usually overnight delivery involves card fee in credit environment. (2-Overnight, 1-Priority , 0-Standard) Valid Values: 0,1,2 Format:xxxx Example:0,1,2 3-Standard Exp 4-Priority Exp 5-Overnight Exp Condition:i. Default value for this tag is '0-Standard'. Condition:Values 3,4,5 are only applicable for Perfect Plastic Card Vendor Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: CardFee
request_fields.description: Fee on Card Shipment. If the value is 1 then fees will be charged and if this is 0 then fees will not be charged. Valid Values: 0-1 Format:xxxx Example:0,1 Condition:Delivery Mechanism = 2(Overnight) then fees will always be charged

request_fields.name: InstantPersonalize
request_fields.description: This flag decides if we want to generate a new card or if want to personalize a card from stack. Valid Values: 0,1 Format:xxxx Example:0,1 Condition: Should be 1 when Decision Flag is 1 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressFlag
request_fields.description: This flag decides if we want to ship the new card to existing address or alternate address or Primary card's address. (Auth User/Secondary Cards only) Valid Values: 0 = Ship to Existing Address 1 = Enter Shipping Address 2 = Ship to Primary Cardholder’s Address Example:2 Condition: 1.Default value would be 0 for Primary cards. 2.Default value would be 2 for Auth User or Secondary Cards

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressCompanyName
request_fields.description: Indicates Company Name for alternate address which need  to be added. Valid Values: 0-9,A-z Format:xxxx Example: XYZ Ltd Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and ShippingAddressFlag as 1 Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressContactName
request_fields.description: Indicates shipping Contact Name for alternate address which need  to be added, Valid Values: 0-9,A-z Format:xxxx Example:XYZ Condition: This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and ShippingAddressFlag as 1. Allowable Values: 152

request_fields.name: AdditionalAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Indicates shipping AddressLine1 for alternate address which need  to be added. Valid Values: 0 - 9, a-z Format: XXXXX Example: XYZ Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and ShippingAddressFlag as 1. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AdditionalAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Indicates shipping AddressLine2 for alternate address which need  to be added. Valid Values: 0 - 9, a-z Format: XXXXX Example: XYZ Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and ShippingAddressFlag as 1 or Country selected as Non-US. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AdditionalAddressCity
request_fields.description: Indicates shipping Address City for alternate address which need  to be added. Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format:xxxx Example:kansas Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and ShippingAddressFlag as 1 or Country selected as Non-US. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: AdditionalAddressCountry
request_fields.description: Indicates shipping Address Country for alternate address which need  to be added. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:xxxx Example:US Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and ShippingAddressFlag as 1 Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: AdditionalAddressState
request_fields.description: Indicates shipping Address State for alternate address which need  to be added Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: GA Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO),ShippingAddressFlag as 1 or Country selected as Non-US. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: AdditionalAddressPostalCode
request_fields.description: Indicates shipping Address PostalCode for alternate address which need  to be added. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:xxxx Example:123456 Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO),ShippingAddressFlag as 1 or Country selected as Non-US. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: CardImageID
request_fields.description: Art/Template ID based on this Card’s Image will be displayed. Valid Values:0-9, a-z Format:XXXX(String) Example:30abc Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:John J Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: NameOnTrack
request_fields.description: Details to be provided in the Magnetic Strip (mostly derived from Last Name and First name of the Card Holder). Valid Values:a-z Format:XXXX Example:John J Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: ActivationCode
request_fields.description: At the time of Account creation/Registration user provide activation code, Present in Account  Parameter accordion which is saved in EmbossingAccounts table. Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Example: AB12345 Condition: This shall be a mandatory tag, if Card Activation Parameter on product is set as 'Activation Code'. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: HoldEmbossing
request_fields.description: Hold Embossing indicator. Valid Values:1= YES, 0 = NO Format:  X Example: 1

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Smith Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Card holder's Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z Format:XXX Example: LEE Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ReplacementOriginalCardStatus
request_fields.description: Indicates the Status of the original card  when request of card replacemnet is made. Possible values are : 1 = Close Existing Card Immediately 3 = Close Existing When New Card Is Activated Default value is 3- Close Existing When New Card Is Activated Valid Values: 1,3 Format: X Example: 1,3

request_fields.name: ReplacementOriginalCardAction
request_fields.description: Indicates the Replacement Original Card Action Possible values are 1 = Cancel 2 = Closed Default value is 1(Cancel) Valid Values: 1,2 Format: X Example: 1,2

request_fields.name: QRCode
request_fields.description: This tag is to to capture the QR Code image file URL. Valid Values: a-z,0-9 Format: url format Example: https://test/qr/d969e78921 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SignatureID
request_fields.description: This tag is to to capture the user signature image file URL. Valid Values: a-z,0-9 Format:url format Example: https://test/qr/d969e78921 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: EmbossingLine4
request_fields.description: Embossing line4 Valid Values: A-Z Example: XYZ Condition:Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 20

response_fields.name: MaskCardNumber
response_fields.description: Masked number of the newly generated card. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: AdminNumber
response_fields.description: Admin Number of the newly generated card and this field will populated only when request creating new embossing. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

response_fields.name: CardExpirationDate
response_fields.description: Card Expiration Date of requested card Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MMYY Example: 0119

response_fields.name: CVV
response_fields.description: This tag refer the CVV of the card Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:123 Allowable Values: 3

response_fields.name: ResponseID
response_fields.description: This number indicates that API responded.Response ID is unique.This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking Valid Values:0-9,a-z Format:xxx Example:200 Allowable Values: 20

response_fields.name: ManualCardStatus
response_fields.description: Card Status when request creating new embossing Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Allowable Values: 50

response_fields.name: OriginalAdminNumber
response_fields.description: Admin number of the original old card. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

response_fields.name: OldCardManualStatus
response_fields.description: Manual status of the old  card. Valid Values: 0-9,a-z Format:XXXXX Example:Active,pending Allowable Values: 50

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
